The '''battle of Bresnia''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==The battle==
Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Karlon]] was killed in a battle against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on [[Bresnia]].<ref name="AJ10" />

==Aftermath==
After his [[Death/Legends|death]], Karlon's best friend, the [[Carosite]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Tamo Lan]], took charge of his seventeen-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old sister, [[Gondara]]. The [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] teenager, who had been living on an Alliance [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] while her brother fought for the Rebellion, subsequently entered active duty and became a member of [[Shroud Team]].<ref name="AJ10" />
